page_title: ATA 5-1 GEN | Atalanta v Genoa 05/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+3' Atalanta are seeing far more of the ball now.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
88' Total attempts – 21:7.
86' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Vitinha trots off the pitch and is replaced by David Ankeye (Genoa).

83' 5 - 1 A superb goal from great team play! Jeff Ekhator (Genoa) latches on to a perfect pass and fires an excellent low shot inside the left post. There is nothing a goalkeeper can do about shots like that.
82' Gian Piero Gasperini prepares a substitution. Mateo Retegui is replaced by Vanja Vlahovic (Atalanta).
81' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Aaron Martin as he is replaced by Brooke Norton-Cuffy (Genoa).

80' 5 - 0 Marten de Roon (Atalanta) gets to the ball on the edge of the box and fires in a first-time shot without any hesitation. The strike is excellent and goes straight into the bottom left corner. He couldn't have done it any better. 5:0.
80' Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
79' The free kick is taken short by Atalanta.
78' Gian Piero Gasperini has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Marco Palestra (Atalanta) replacing Raoul Bellanova.
78' That will be all from Ederson who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Ibrahim Sulemana (Atalanta).
77' Nicolo Zaniolo (Atalanta) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
74' 4 - 0 Goal! Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) puts the ball into the bottom left corner past the outstretched arm of Pierluigi Gollini.
74' Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
73' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Atalanta!
72' There's a break in play and referee Daniele Chiffi must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Atalanta using VAR. This could be interesting!
72' Alessandro Vogliacco (Genoa) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!
70' Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
69' Substitution. Charles De Ketelaere makes his way off the pitch and Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) comes on as his replacement.
68' The referee signals a substitution. Nicolo Zaniolo (Atalanta) is brought on as a substitute for Ademola Lookman.
67' Substitution. Filippo Melegoni (Genoa) on for Fabio Miretti.
67' Alberto Gilardino decides to make a substitution. Andrea Pinamonti will be replaced by Jeff Ekhator (Genoa).

67' A cross is whipped into the centre of the box towards Mateo Retegui (Atalanta). He gets a good contact on the ball but heads it high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Genoa will have a goal kick.
65' Atalanta are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.

62' CHANCE! Sead Kolasinac finds Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) with a sweet pass, but he can't find the target as his effort from inside the box goes just over the bar! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Genoa.
60' 3 - 0 An excellent first touch by Ederson (Atalanta), who collects a splendid pass and from the edge of the box slams the ball into the top right corner!
58' 62:38 – the latest ball possession ratio.

55' Isak Hien (Atalanta) leaps high deep inside the box to meet a beautiful cross from the resultant free kick. He glances a header goalwards, but it's not accurate and goes narrowly wide of the left post.
53' The ball is out of play. Atalanta will take a throw-in.
50' 2 - 0 Goal! Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the left post. It's 2:0.
49' Aaron Martin (Genoa) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
46' Alberto Gilardino has made a change at the break. Alessandro Vogliacco has come on in place of Mattia Bani (Genoa).
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
45' Koni De Winter (Genoa) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Daniele Chiffi blows his whistle for a foul. Atalanta win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
44' The linesman signals a throw-in for Atalanta.
42' The ball goes out of play. Genoa are awarded a corner kick.

41' Sead Kolasinac (Atalanta) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Genoa will have a goal kick.
40' Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
38' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) fails to deliver a decent cross from the corner and the ball goes out of play.
37' Atalanta will take a corner kick.
36' Shots on target – 2:0.
34' Some patient build-up play from Atalanta as they look to unlock the defence.
31' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Pierluigi Gollini.
30' The ball goes out of play and Atalanta will have a goal kick.
26' Handball by Fabio Miretti (Genoa).

24' 1 - 0 Goal! A terrific long pass from Ademola Lookman picks out an unmarked Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) inside the box. He has time and space to pick his spot and slams the ball into the bottom right corner. 1:0.
23' Sead Kolasinac (Atalanta) tackles a bit over-zealously and Daniele Chiffi blows for a foul. Genoa win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
20' A player from Genoa commits a rough challenge. Daniele Chiffi blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
18' The percentage of ball possession is – 53:47.
17' Genoa earn a corner.
15' Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) commits a rough foul. Daniele Chiffi stops the game and makes a call. A free kick has been awarded to Genoa.

13' A dangerous towering header by Isak Hien (Atalanta) from around the penalty spot goes just wide of the right post. This corner kick didn't change the score. The ball goes out of play and Genoa will have a goal kick.
13' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Atalanta.
11' Daniele Chiffi interrupts the game. One of the players from Atalanta won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. Genoa have a free kick.
9' Genoa players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
6' A shot from the edge of the box by Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) is close, but lifts narrowly over the bar at the last second. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Genoa.
5' Emil Bohinen (Genoa) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Daniele Chiffi has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
4' Ederson (Atalanta) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. Free kick. Genoa will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
2' The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Genoa.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out and the match is about to start. Genoa will have the kick-off.
The match will be delayed due to minute of silence.
The referee of today's match will be Daniele Chiffi.
Show lineups Before the start of the game, you can see the starting lineups for today's clash.
